verdict.rationale: Claude is fundamentally a natural-language chat interface where users describe outcomes and Claude executes—covering file generation, spreadsheet/document creation, browser/computer control, scheduled tasks, and research, all driven by prompting in plain language rather than special commands (claude-docs-15, claude-docs-4, claude-docs-6, claude-docs-7, claude-docs-38, claude-docs-27). Community feedback corroborates real-world natural-language usage for coding and research tasks (claude-comm-12, claude-comm-9). Missing for 10: no independent benchmark specifically testing NL command robustness across all surfaces, and some community notes mention friction with the CLI interface (claude-comm-13).
